## About
Dick's Auto Service is a small, family-style shop on Aaron Lane in Clinton. Dick built the brick and block building himself, and the company has grown one customer at a time.
Dick later handed the shop to his employees Larry and Dwight, who still put their names on the work. Larry is ASE certified. Dwight is ASE Master Certified and a Certified Maryland Emissions Technician. Whether it's an oil change or a major engine or transmission job, every job gets the same planning, care, and cost-effective results.
Bring us your compact, full size or vintage car, or your light truck. We're rated 4.9 from 35 Google reviews, and our business has thrived on the referral of satisfied customers.

## Services
- Oil & filter change: Routine oil and filter changes to keep your engine running right.
- Factory scheduled maintenance: The same factory scheduled maintenance the dealer does, at 30, 60, and 90 thousand mile intervals.
- Brake pads and shoes: Brake pad and shoe replacement, plus hoses, lines and cylinders when they need it.
- Anti-lock (ABS) systems: Diagnosis and repair of anti-lock brake systems.
- Air conditioning service: A/C service, with freon from your system captured and recycled.
- Engine overhaul & replacement: Major engine work, using Jasper Engines.
- Transmission overhaul & replacement: Transmission rebuilds and replacements, using Jasper Transmissions.

## FAQ
Q: Can I get an estimate before you start?
A: Yes. We give free estimates by phone or internet, so you have a good idea of the bottom line and fewer surprises.

Q: Will having my new car serviced here keep my warranty in force?
A: Yes. We're a qualified service provider for the factory scheduled maintenance your warranty requires, so there's no need to go to the dealer.

Q: Can I drop my car off before or after hours?
A: Yes. We have an early morning and nighttime drop off box.

Q: How do I get home or to work while my car is in the shop?
A: Just ask. We'll give you a ride to or from the Branch Avenue Metro station or a local address.

Q: How can I pay?
A: We take cash and Visa, MasterCard and Discover.
